name: Paradoxical Covenant
text: Permanent. Limit 1 [[Covenant]] per deck. [reaction] After an investigator at your location performs the "reveal the chaos token" step of a skill test, if both a [bless] token and a [curse] token were revealed during that test, exhaust Paradoxical Covenant: This test automatically succeeds. (Remove each [bless] and [curse] token revealed from the chaos bag after this test ends.)
text_cn: 永久。每副牌组限制1张[[圣约]]。 [reaction]你所在地点的调查员在执行技能检定的"抽出混乱标记"步骤(步骤3)后，如果该检定中同时抽出[bless]标记和[curse]标记，消耗矛盾圣约：这次检定自动成功。(在这次检定结束后，移除所有从混乱袋抽出的[bless]和[curse]标记。)
